scope: Bounded discovery of German federal legal-publication channels; EU/EEA/Swiss residence, visas and mission practice; civil status/adoption; procedure, remedies, courts, privacy/oversight, public access and legal aid. Land-level practice is represented by selected examples only. This is not a legal-equivalence opinion or complete national inventory.

comparison_seed.source: Danish EU-residence regulation and official guidance used as the comparison seed
comparison_seed.relationship_note: FreizügG/EU shares subject and some functions with the seed but differs in structure, scope and authority allocation. Similarity does not establish equivalent provisions. EU, EEA EFTA, Swiss, UK Withdrawal Agreement and German-citizen family routes remain distinct.

previous_findings_carried_forward: The 15-source Germany proposal in the 2026-10-15 acquisition register was reconciled, including GAD, KonsG, VwVfG § 2, IFG, civil-status/adoption laws, FreizügG/EU, VwGO, AABGebV and AZRG. Prior URLs remain leads unless inspected here.

Czechia’s date-bound PDF approach, Estonia’s XML route, Finland’s keyless API documentation and France’s public bulk-data route are adapter-design examples only; they do not establish a German source/API.
Prior Denmark-to-Sweden/Finland and Austria findings were used as query leads, not evidence of German legal equivalence or complete coverage.
